repository.name: mapbox-gl-js
repository.description: Interactive, thoroughly customizable maps in the browser, powered by vector tiles and WebGL

issue.body:
[ESLint](http://eslint.org/) is really awesome. My first try switching from JSHint to it and I love it.
- Unlike JSHint which basically detects errors with string regexps, it actually parses JS into AST, so it lints more accurately and with less bugs. 
- It has [many more useful rules](http://eslint.org/docs/rules/) that help preventing errors in code — I was able to fix a few bugs after its hints.
- It's much more configurable, and has an awesome modular system with plugins
- It detects a lot of styling errors including whitespace stuff, while JSHint dropped a lot of those checks (e.g. `white: true`)
- Vibrant community and very active development

Fixed lots of minor code style and consistency issues and a few bugs, and suggest enforcing consistent coding style from now on. Also had to relax a lot of the options because they either require discussion or are not applicable in the project. A few had minor issues I [reported](https://github.com/eslint/eslint/issues/created_by/mourner).

I think we should eventually go through all available rules that are currently disabled but make sense, and enable gradually after agreeing on a certain style or how to fix underlying code.

cc @jfirebaugh @tmcw

issue.title: brace-style when `if` does not need braces but `else` does

repository.name: eslint
repository.description: Find and fix problems in your JavaScript code.

issue.body:
## Here's what I did

Create a new directory.
Create `file.js` with the text:

```
var f
if (true)
    f = function() {
        return 1
    }
else {
    var x = 1
    f = x
}
```

Create `package.json` with the text:

```
{
    "eslintConfig": {
        "rules": {
            "brace-style": [ 1, "1tbs", { "allowSingleLine": true } ],
            "curly": [ 1, "multi" ],
            "indent": [ 1, "tab" ],
            "no-constant-condition": 0,
            "no-unused-vars": 0,
            "semi": 0,
            "strict": 0
        }
    }
}
```

Then do:

```
npm install eslint/eslint
node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js file.js
```
## Here's what happened

```
file.js
  6:5  warning  Closing curly brace does not appear on the same line as the subsequent block  brace-style

✖ 1 problem (0 errors, 1 warning)
```
## Here's what I expected to happen

I don't think this should be considered an error.
If the `if` statement had braces I would want the `else` to match with them.
But only the `function` has braces, and it would look silly to put `else` on the same line as the end of the function.
